name.description: Optional friendly name for the device. If omitted, orchestrator may fall back to host.

addresses.description: Optional list of IP addresses or hostnames for the device. Typically at least one is used.

host.description: Optional single host/IP. If provided and addresses is omitted, orchestrator may use this as addresses=[host].

port.description: Optional service port for the device.

properties.description: Optional free-form metadata object (or any JSON value).
